name: whiteboard-ink
description: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

vars.description: Authored preset sketch to draw. Ignored when the strokes slot holds custom paths.
Short line shown after the sketch completes.
Show or hide the pen nib actor.
Color used by strokes marked data-ink=accent (one highlight stroke in each preset).
How the completed lockup leaves. none holds the final frame.
